expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const q = btns.find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('qwen2.5-coder:7b')); const d = btns.find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('deepseek-v4-flash')); if (q) q.click(); if (d) d.click(); return 'selected=' + ((q?'ollama,':'') + (d?'deepseek':'')).replace(/,$/,''); })()

(() => { const pressed = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[aria-pressed=true]')).length; const runBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('Run comparison')); return 'chipsSelected=' + pressed + ';runDisabled=' + (runBtn ? runBtn.disabled : 'n/a'); })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('Run comparison')); if (!b) return 'no run button'; b.click(); return 'clicked Run comparison'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body && document.body.innerText; return t && (t.match(/completed/g) || []).length >= 2; })()
(() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).map(r => (r.innerText||'').replace(/\n/g,' | ')); return 'ROWS(' + rows.length + '): ' + rows.join(' ;; '); })()
